    g=[row[:] for row in grid]

    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c,v in cells}
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1

        if all(g[i+r][j+c]==0 for r,c in shape):

'''
